lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Wednesday's Parks & Recreation Commission meeting, where the already-approved plan to pave Town Park's grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts comes back up — more than 400 signatures and letters in opposition make this one worth showing up for. The Gondola Leadership Committee also convenes Monday with what looks like substantive action items, including a briefing on Capital Investment Grant funding commitments. Elsewhere, Town Council sits as the Liquor Licensing Authority Sunday to hear KOTO Radio's special event permit for Live at the Drive on July 30.
